Type: faceted metal planter
Use: holding a potted plant; living room, home office, bedroom, on a floor, shelf or console
Style: industrial, modern, glam
Materials: metal with an iridescent burnished gold finish
Colors: antique gold, bronze, blue and purple patina tints
Shape: hexagonal faceted geometric body, wide open top, squat and chunky, medium size
Feel: bold, moody, earthy, luxe
Goes with: dark wood, black metal, leather, green plants; industrial or modern rooms

Type: geometric stoneware vase

Materials: glazed stoneware, glossy finish
Colors: white

Feel: crisp, bright, sculptural
